projects.title: STATARB Trader
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a **cointegration-based statistical arbitrage trading algorithm** to identify and exploit mean-reverting relationships between correlated securities
- Implemented **advanced statistical and machine learning techniques**, including OLS regression and z-score-based signal generation, to optimize entry and exit points
- Integrated **real-time market data APIs** for live price tracking and automated trade execution, ensuring low-latency, reliable operations
- Built **backtesting and performance evaluation framework** to assess strategy profitability and risk metrics across multiple securities and timeframes
